inputs.label: Maintainer capacity and continuity
inputs.limitation: No maintainer-time telemetry or staffed independent backup is observed; the range is a planning envelope, not a measured workload.

inputs.label: CI and artifact operations
inputs.limitation: The repository records commands and artifacts but no invoice, hosted quota, or committed compute price.

inputs.label: Dependency and workflow upkeep
inputs.limitation: Dependabot cadence and review responsibilities are public; actual update volume and time are not observed.

inputs.label: Support and contributor burden
inputs.limitation: There is no consented support-load series or external contributor record, so the model retains a wide planning range.

inputs.label: Security response reserve
inputs.limitation: Tabletop deadlines are internal rehearsal targets, not an incident-rate forecast or public response SLA.

inputs.label: Adapter ownership and compatibility
inputs.limitation: Adapter role paths are documented but backup staffing is unverified; no adapter support hours are measured.

inputs.label: Release and distribution work
inputs.limitation: The package release is rehearsed locally and has no public release history or publication invoice in this snapshot.

inputs.label: Approved hosted or service operations
inputs.limitation: No hosted service, account, source-ingestion path, or background collector is approved; hosted expansion requires a new gate.

scenarios.label: OSS-only local-first maintenance

components.label: Core graph, evidence, and CLI contracts
components.assumption: Reserve time for compatibility, deterministic fixtures, and bounded contract review each quarter.

components.label: Roadmap and evidence governance
components.assumption: Keep dependencies, issue evidence, claims limitations, and quarterly decisions reconciled.

components.label: Release and rollback rehearsal
components.assumption: Run a local package, provenance, compatibility, and rollback rehearsal without assuming publication.

components.label: Dependency and Action update review
components.assumption: Review the weekly npm and monthly Action proposals, lockfile impact, security, and license changes.

components.label: Support and contributor requests
components.assumption: Cover bounded issue triage, contributor questions, and documentation updates without a support SLA.

components.label: Security intake and tabletop reserve
components.assumption: Reserve review capacity for private reports, containment, fixture replay, and coordinated disclosure decisions.

components.label: Adapter support and compatibility review
components.assumption: Review bounded adapter evidence, ownership gaps, support windows, and retirement triggers.

components.label: CI, benchmark, and artifact execution
components.assumption: Use the public-repository allowance or donated compute as a planning assumption; no hosted invoice is observed.

components.label: Approved hosted service operations
components.assumption: No hosted service or account-bearing operation is approved in the local-first branch.

assumptions: Hours are quarterly planning ranges, not observed time records.
The USD 100–200 per hour rate prices maintainer labor even when the current work is volunteer; it is not a compensation offer.
Public CI or donated compute may make direct spend low, but its opportunity cost and quota risk are not zero.
The repository remains local-first, unreleased, and without a hosted service.

breakEven.condition: Continue only while available maintainer capacity covers the 21–70 hour quarterly range and direct spend remains reviewable; no funding or hosted break-even claim is made.

stopConditions: Pause roadmap expansion when the upper capacity range cannot be staffed.
Stop or narrow work when security, support, or release obligations displace core correctness.
Require a new cost, privacy, and security review before adding hosted or account-bearing operations.
nonGoals: This is not an invoice, budget approval, salary survey, or public funding claim.
This option does not promise response times, support coverage, or a public package release.

scenarios.label: Funded OSS stewardship without hosted expansion

components.label: Core graph, evidence, and CLI contracts
components.assumption: Add funded review and compatibility capacity while preserving the local contract.

components.label: Roadmap and evidence governance
components.assumption: Fund independent review, claims maintenance, and explicit quarterly investment decisions.

components.label: Release and rollback rehearsal
components.assumption: Support reproducible release and recovery work without presuming npm publication.

components.label: Dependency and Action update review
components.assumption: Review update proposals more frequently when funded scope increases, still with explicit major-version decisions.

components.label: Support and contributor requests
components.assumption: Provide bounded contributor onboarding and issue triage capacity without converting it into a response SLA.

components.label: Security intake and tabletop reserve
components.assumption: Reserve a second-reviewer and incident-response budget while retaining private intake and local reproduction.

components.label: Adapter support and compatibility review
components.assumption: Staff bounded adapter ownership and independent conformance review; broad language claims remain out of scope.

components.label: CI, benchmark, and artifact execution
components.assumption: Budget for reproducible compute or artifact retention only after actual quotas and invoices are reviewed.

components.label: Approved hosted service operations
components.assumption: No hosted service is approved; funding covers OSS stewardship only.

assumptions: Hours are quarterly planning ranges for a funded OSS stewardship track, not a commitment to hire or spend.
The USD 150–250 per hour rate prices labor and review capacity; it is not a compensation offer or market benchmark.
A sponsor or grant must cover the upper modeled quarterly total before this branch is authorized.
Hosted service operations, source upload, telemetry, and account-bearing support remain outside this option.

breakEven.condition: Do not fund this branch unless a committed sponsor or grant budget covers the conservative upper quarterly range of USD 37,230 and names an accountable steward.

stopConditions: Stop funded scope when the committed budget falls below the upper range for two review periods.
Stop or narrow work when a second reviewer, security responder, or adapter owner cannot be staffed.
Do not convert funding into hosted expansion without a new privacy, security, service-cost, and governance gate.
nonGoals: This option does not authorize a hosted product, source ingestion, telemetry, or account service.
This option does not claim market demand, revenue, grant availability, or external contributor adoption.
